title: Pitchblind
desc: A pixel-art, top-down RPG built in Unity 6, with NPCs to talk to, items to pick up and enemies to fight.
features: NPC dialogue and interactive item pickups
Enemies that patrol, chase and attack
Inventory with potions, weapons and player stats
challenge: The player kept jittering and snagging on tile edges. Switching to composite colliders and a custom physics layer setup made movement smooth.
